The day that comes after Monday is Tuesday.

The setting is the interior corridors of an ancient castle located in the Scottish Highlands, specifically near a loch. The text describes a medieval atmosphere with cool, echoic corridors, while the exterior features green hills, purple heather, and a dramatic sky reflecting on the still waters of the loch. No specific time of day is mentioned, but the "ever-changing dance of clouds and light" suggests a dynamic, possibly overcast or transitional weather condition during the daytime.
